description: A proof_summaries write whose question's search_stop.stop_criteria.conflict_resolution claims a conflict was resolved, while conflicts[] holds no record of it. Replayed by the harness detector (find_unpersisted_conflict_resolutions) and the research_append precondition (unpersistedConflictResolutionInvariants); both must agree on every case.
format: expect: fire | silent, judged for the summary named by `write` in `research` (the live document the write produces). Every fire case carries a `shape`; a guard needs at least two distinct fire shapes and at least one silent case (ADR-0011). known_let_through marks a silent case the guard knowingly misses, kept so a change that closes it is noticed.
